reference.reference_note: The renderer's _safe_name (terrain_piece_render.py:117,136-140) rejects spaces in filenames, so the read-only reference JPEG was copied under a safe name into a TEMP ref dir and --reference-dir was used only for the comparison tile. No repo asset was added.

donor.tree_rule: dogenerate.inc:1975-1982 deletes objects whose basename contains 'leaftree' in winter; conifers survive

reference.variance: V1: spec uses a single spruce sprite (generated-map mode); screenshot shows >=1 bare broadleaf per view (scenario mode).

adaptation.base: grass1_winter -> winter10 (alias map winter_variant.md §1.2); NOT winter11 (gravel) or winter23-26 (green grass).
adaptation.cool_glaze: Upgraded renderer provides a real 'glaze' layer (terrain_piece_render.py:173-179,1090-1121) with white_floor: pixels >= floor are forced to exact #FFFFFF, lower pixels get the cool tint. The old water-tint proxy was REMOVED. Glaze is placed below the conifer sprite so the tree cue survives.
adaptation.glaze_limitation: Exact #FFFFFF and B>=R cool bias now coexist, but exact near-white hexes (#F7F7F7 etc.) are consumed by white_floor, and strict B>R is impossible on forced-white pixels (B=R). Both are reported; no threshold was relaxed.
adaptation.tree: tree_spruce1 only; leaftree objects are destroyed in donor winter generated maps -> 0 bare trees is correct for V1 generated-map mode.
